t: This is the Finsbury Health Centre in Clerkenwell, a Grade I listed building. It was built between 1935 and 1938, designed by Berthold Lubetkin and the Tecton architecture practice. Its materials and detailing are shared with other Lubetkin projects of the period, including the Priory Green, Spa Green and Hallfield Estates. Lubetkin was a Russian-born British architect who pioneered modernist design in Britain in the 1930s. His work also includes Highpoint and the Penguin Pool at London Zoo.
